assertions.subject: synovial sarcomas
assertions.quote: Ninety percent of synovial sarcomas contain a characteristic chromosomal translocation t(X;18)(p11;q11)

assertions.subject: synovial sarcomas
assertions.predicate: translocations to the second X breakpoint (SSX2)
assertions.quote: Patients with translocations to the second X breakpoint (SSX2) may have longer survival

assertions.subject: some sarcomas
assertions.quote: Insulin-like growth factor (IGF) type II is produced by some sarcomas

assertions.subject: IGF-II
assertions.quote: If secreted in large amounts, IGF-II may produce hypoglycemia

assertions.subject: rhabdomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: rhabdomyosarcoma shows evidence of skeletal muscle fibers with cross-striations

assertions.subject: leiomyosarcomas
assertions.predicate: interlacing fascicles of spindle cells resembling smooth muscle
assertions.quote: leiomyosarcomas contain interlacing fascicles of spindle cells resembling smooth muscle

assertions.subject: malignant fibrous histiocytoma (MFH)
assertions.predicate: mixture of spindle (fibrous) cells and round (histiocytic) cells
assertions.quote: malignant fibrous histiocytoma (MFH) includes many tumors previously classified as fibrosarcomas or as pleomorphic variants of other sarcomas and is characterized by a mixture of spindle (fibrous) cells and round (histiocytic) cells

assertions.subject: Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma
assertions.predicate: storiform pattern with frequent giant cells and areas of pleomorphism
assertions.quote: the terms undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma (UPS) and myxofibrosarcoma are replacing MFH and myxoid MFH
